amendment: Winning Combination Amendment 3 (ratified 2026-11-01): the ledger's schema is declared here, versioned, and pinned beside the artifact; program-ledger/intake.py validates every entry against it in the intake path and in CI.

fields.name: id
fields.provenance: assigned at intake; unique across the ledger; never reused

fields.name: text
fields.provenance: the atomic claim statement, in the author's words; corrections are new entries, never edits

fields.name: kind
fields.provenance: the engine claim kind (for example hypothesis, measurement, decision)

fields.name: status
fields.provenance: the engine claim status; moves only by a recomputable verdict or an appended reclassification

fields.name: stage
fields.provenance: the digestion stage: created, checked, explained, accepted, or digested

fields.name: domain
fields.provenance: the program domain the claim belongs to

fields.name: source_ref
fields.provenance: pointer to the record the claim was drawn from (repo path, run id, or document); a claim with no source does not enter

fields.name: falsification_tests
fields.provenance: at least one test that would refute the claim, stated by the claim's author at intake

fields.name: boundary
fields.provenance: at least one 'this does not establish' line, stated by the claim's author at intake

fields.name: evidence
fields.provenance: at least one evidence item; each item requires ref, kind, direction, source_quality, and description, all recorded when the evidence was gathered; content_hash and observed_at and source_id are recorded when the source is hashable or dated

fields.name: metadata
fields.provenance: requires date (ISO, the date the claim entered) and components (ids from components.json)

fields.name: confidence
fields.provenance: the author's confidence as a number between 0 and 1 (the engine model's own range rule), recorded at intake; the qualitative band is derived by the model from the number, never stored in its place

fields.name: depends_on
fields.provenance: ids of claims this claim rests on; must resolve inside the ledger

fields.name: conflicts_with
fields.provenance: ids of claims this claim contradicts; must resolve inside the ledger

fingerprint.input: the claim's text, normalized: Unicode NFC, case-folded, whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces, stripped
fingerprint.rule: computed by the validator on every run, never read from the artifact; two entries with distinct ids and equal fingerprints are refused as a proposition collision (the dedupe discipline)
